'''Caliqu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as the [[Dark Council]]'s emissary and [[Cendence]]'s superior. He was present at the time when [[Jaesa Willsaam]] killed Cendence and granted her the hunter's mandate.
